items.reason: The lower 2.5% strength is a gentler way to clear up the look of breakouts on oily skin, and a rinse-off wash keeps contact short.
A light ceramide moisturizer supports a comfortable skin barrier and helps offset dryness from the wash.
A mineral SPF 50 protects skin in the morning and suits sensitive skin.

response.routine_note: Use the wash once a day in the evening at first, then moisturizer, with sunscreen every morning. Since you are trying for a baby, check any active product with your doctor or pharmacist, and I have left out retinoids and other strong exfoliants to keep this simple and cautious.
